name: vibeagent
description: Project-aware command-line coding agent with safe tools, sessions, and provider-neutral model adapters.

scripts.build: npm run build:python && npm run build:ide
scripts.build:ide: npm --prefix extensions/vscode run check && python3 scripts/build_vscode_extension.py
scripts.test:v1: python3 -m unittest tests.test_v1_acceptance tests.test_v1_dogfood tests.test_v1_cli_smoke tests.test_project_prompt_commands tests.test_v1_live_dogfood -q
scripts.test:v1:full: npm run test:v1 && npm run test:ide && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -q
scripts.test:v1:release: npm run build && npm run test:install && npm run test:v1:full
